---
title: Read the log
guide-section: Use it
---

Open **Settings > Add-ons > AppDaemon > Log**.

## Lines

Each line starts with the app's name from `apps.yaml`:

```
INFO <app name>: <action>: <reason>; <details>
```

| Line | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `load: init` | The app loaded. Lists its settings. |
| `check: start trigger` | Something started the app, such as a set time or its test event |
| An error naming the app | The app did not load. See [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.qmd). |

Each app group lists its own lines. Lights: [Light app log](../docs/apps/light-log.qmd).

## More detail

Some lines are hidden at the default log level. To see them for one app, add `log_level: DEBUG` to its entry in `apps.yaml`:

```yaml
bedroom_sunrise:
  module: sunrise_fade
  class: SunriseFade
  light: light.bedroom_lamp
  log_level: DEBUG
```

Remove the line when you are done.

## From your computer

```sh
ssh root@homeassistant.local ha addons logs a0d7b954_appdaemon
```
